work.title: Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67

version.note: No modern performing edition is established; the source audio is not locally edited or concatenated.

alternatives.value: Odeon Grand Orchestra; Friedrich Kark, conductor — older attribution
Odeon company orchestra; Eduard Künneke, conductor — Hepokoski’s inference, not named on the original labels

performers.note: Internet Archive and the 2015 Science Museum article attribute the record to Kark in 1910. James Hepokoski’s publisher-deposited 2023 abstract dates the Odeon Fifth to August 1911 and infers Künneke because the labels name no conductor. The full article was unavailable; the older attribution is retained as a documented dispute.
